DC_DESCRIPTOR_FREE(3) Library Functions Manual DC_DESCRIPTOR_FREE(3)

NAME

dc_descriptor_free — free a dive computer descriptor reference

LIBRARY

library “libdivecomputer”

SYNOPSIS

#include <libdivecomputer/descriptor.h>

void
dc_descriptor_free(dc_descriptor_t *descriptor);

DESCRIPTION

Frees a descriptor usually returned with dc_iterator_next(3) as created with dc_descriptor_iterator_new(3). It's safe to pass NULL to this function.

SEE ALSO

dc_descriptor_iterator_new(3), dc_iterator_free(3)
